description: A toolkit for Zig 0.17 whose largest module is an HTTP server on zio fibers (io_uring, epoll, kqueue). A plain function is a route: its argument list is the routing, the typed input, the 400 for anything that does not fit, and the OpenAPI document. One allocation per request, 4,669 bytes per idle connection, and a wait parks the fiber rather than the thread. Serves HTTP/1.1 and h2c on 8080, TLS 1.3 on 8081, h2c on 8082 and HTTP/2 over TLS with ALPN on 8443 from one process. HTTP/2 and unary gRPC are behind the -Dhttp2 build flag, which this entry builds with; gRPC is unary only, so the streaming profiles are not subscribed. Refuses HTTP/3 and templates on the record, which is why it sits out those profiles.
